# Fira Sans regression font

Test-only regular Fira Sans from google/fonts at `7af0d90b4d532ffa4b041937b560c6df4e7b1e95`:
`ofl/firasans/FiraSans-Regular.ttf`. License: OFL.txt (SIL OFL 1.1).
Used to replay the FB2 paragraph overlap reported with Fira Sans, 13.5 pt,
130% line spacing and 80% word spacing. Not added to application assets.
This is a public reproducibility fixture, not proof of byte identity with
the user's Kobo-installed font.
